scenario: A global shipping company compares two cargo-routing systems across transatlantic, Mediterranean, and polar routes. Leadership prefers System A because its overall on-time arrival rate is much higher.

data.description: On-time arrival by route family and system.

question: (a) Which system performs better in each route family? (b) If the target traffic mix is 45% transatlantic, 35% Mediterranean, and 20% polar, compute the corrected on-time rate for each system. (c) Which system should be preferred?

ground_truth.explanation: System B is better in every stratum; System A only looks better overall because it handled a far easier route mix.

naive_answer: System A is better because its aggregate on-time rate is much higher.
naive_trap: Aggregate performance is driven by route allocation, not route quality.
